title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing degree in CS or related quantitative field; experience in C++, Java, or Python.
description: Work on real-world projects that impact millions of users across Search, Cloud, and Android platforms while collaborating with experienced engineers.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from eligible participating countries worldwide.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, living stipend, airfare, health insurance)
qualification: Completed undergraduate degree with strong academic standing.
description: Enables graduate students and young professionals from abroad to study and conduct research at universities in the United States.

title: Junior Frontend Developer (React)
eligibility: Open to early-career developers globally with stable internet and proficient English skills.
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.
description: Join GitLab's engineering team to build maintainable, user-friendly open-source web interfaces used by millions of developers.

title: Chevening Master's Scholarships
eligibility: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries with at least 2 years of work experience.
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition fees, monthly allowance, travel expenses)
qualification: Undergraduate degree suitable for UK master's program entry.
description: The UK government’s global scholarship program offering full financial support to study for a one-year master's degree at any UK university.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of product management experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Design, or equivalent practical experience.
description: Guide products from inception to launch through Meta's rotational APM program, working across Instagram, WhatsApp, and Reality Labs.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide; no prior programming experience required.
description: An entry-level course teaching how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
